bearingSource: OSM way 1309357327 long axis 48.1°; +X points to the polygonal apse end of the outline (NE); the porch front faces the access road (SW) as in photos 01 and 03.
approximations: The front and one long side are photographed (2026); the apse and the north-east half are inferred from the OSM outline. Heights scaled from the 14 m front (eave ≈ 9.4 m, cross ≈ 20.8 m); the drum position along the axis, the arch counts and the roof pitch (the roof is hardly visible in the photographs) are estimated.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice de referință din 2026. Cupola, fusta turlei și acoperișurile joase sunt redate în cupru deja patinat spre brun închis, așa cum apar în fotografii — material livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale. Absida și latura nefotografiată sunt deduse din conturul clădirii.
note.hu: 2026-os nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett. A kupola, a dob alatti tetőszoknya és a lapos tetők sötétbarnára patinásodott rézként jelennek meg, ahogy a fotókon — a COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint általa szállított anyag. Az apszis és a nem fotózott oldal az épület körvonalából következtetett.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs taken in 2026. The dome, the drum skirt and the low roofs are shown in copper already weathered to dark brown, as photographed — the material supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records. The apse and the unphotographed side are inferred from the building outline.
